evidence: Packs day (bits 16-20), month (8-11) and year (0-7) into the profile identifier; called from FrontendProfile_ApplyDateEntry with the three date items of the menu.
Unpacks day, month and year from the identifier of the driver's profile; the .pps file name is built from the same fields.
Fills the day/month/year items from RallyData_GetDriverDateOfBirth and limits the day to 30 for April, June, September and November.
Stores the five ints (x, y, z, heading, value) written by RallyData_SetDriverCameraOffsets into the driver record or profile.
Returns the camera offsets record that RallyData_GetDriverCameraOffsets reads and the camera menu copies.
Sets the edited bit of the championship entry or the dirty flag of the driver's profile.
Returns the TyreWear block of the driver record or profile (NULL for time-trial ghosts).
Returns the ProfileEventResults of the driver's profile.
Returns the CategoryBestResults of the driver's profile, NULL without one.
Returns the HUD flags byte; RallyData and Dash_Draw test its 4/8/0x10/0x20 bits to draw the HUD panels.
Stores the HUD flags byte of the driver record or profile.
Returns &ProfileEventResults::rallyStageTime in the record modes that have one, else NULL.
Returns ProfileEventResults::rallyResult in modes 0, 1 and 8, else NULL.
Copies the event stage time into rallyStageTimes[country][stage] when it is lower or none is stored.
Merges the event rally result into rallyResults[country][difficulty] when it is better.
Merges the event player result into playerResults[difficulty] when it is better.
Copies the event arcade stage time into arcadeStageTimes when it is lower or none is stored.
Merges the event arcade result into arcadeResults when it is better.
Clears ProfileEventResults::playerPoints and the three placing counters.
Adds to playerPoints and counts a first, second or third place.
Writes the level and score fields of ProfileEventResults::playerResult and clears playerPoints.
Stores ProfileEventResults::arcadeStageTime.
Writes the fields of ProfileEventResults::arcadeResult and arcadeExtra.
Stores the value through Frontend_GetEventRallyStageTime.
Writes the fields of the rally result word and its time through Frontend_GetEventRallyResult.
Keeps the lowest event rally stage time in g_lowestSplitValue.
Keeps the lowest event arcade stage time in g_lowestSplitValue.
Returns the DriverProfileIdentifier of the n-th .pps file found.
Copies the DriverProfileIdentifier at +0x10 of a .pps file.
Plays HLIGHT1/HLIGHT2 (kind 0) or SCREEN1 (kind 2) from g_glassFirstSample; called when a window or light part breaks.
